chat.pageIntro: Ask about your booking, the estimated refund if you cancel, or property rules.
chat.disclosure: You are chatting with an AI assistant. It cannot approve refunds, cancellations or payments; when needed it hands the conversation to our human support team.
chat.label: Your message
chat.hint: Do not share personal data (ID number, card, IBAN).
chat.handoff: Handed over to our human support team. Ticket no: {id}.
chat.humanMessage: I would like to talk to a human agent.
chat.humanHint: If the AI answer is not enough, you can hand the conversation straight to our human support team; your message is passed to the team.
chat.humanPending: Your request was forwarded to our human support team. An agent will reply to the email address on your account; you can follow the ticket status in the list at the top of this page.
chat.bookingNone: None selected (your nearest booking is used)
chat.thinking: The assistant is preparing a reply…
chat.standaloneHint: The assistant answers each message on its own and does not remember earlier ones; ask your full question in one message.
chat.suggestTitle: Start with a ready-made question (it is sent as soon as you choose it):

suggest.bookingStatus: What is the status of my booking?
suggest.cancellationQuote: If I cancel now, how much will I get back?
suggest.checkInTimes: What are the check-in and check-out times?

chat.shortcutHint: Press Ctrl+Enter (⌘+Enter on Mac) to send.
chat.nearLimit: Messages can be at most {max} characters; you are close to the limit.
chat.truncated: The pasted text did not fit; your message was cut to {max} characters.
chat.prefillAccessibility: {hasProperty, select, yes {I have a question about the accessibility of “{property}”: } other {I have a question about a property’s accessibility: }}
chat.atLimit: You have reached the {max}-character limit; no more text can be added.
chat.agentOff: The assistant is offline right now; use “{button}” to reach our team.

intent.prompt_injection: Attempt to change the assistant's instructions

cancellation.question: How do I cancel my booking?
cancellation.answer: You can cancel your booking under <link>My account › My bookings</link>. How much you get back depends on the listing's cancellation policy and when you cancel; the terms are shown on the listing page and again before you pay.

refund.question: When will I get my refund?
refund.answer: Refunds to your card usually appear within 5–10 business days. For a problem with your stay, open a refund claim from the booking page and follow it in the <link>Resolution center</link>.

payment.question: Is my payment safe?
payment.answer: Your card number is not stored on the platform; payments are processed by the payment provider and only a token and the transaction reference are kept. More in the <link>Trust center</link>.

accessibility.question: How do I find a stay that meets my accessibility needs?
accessibility.answer: Use the accessibility filters on the <link>search</link> page. Listing pages show only features our team has verified against evidence; missing information does not mean a feature is missing. If you have a specific need, ask the assistant on this page before booking or ask to be connected to the human support team (sign-in required).
